paraphrase: Śiva tells Umā the classification of the Purāṇas: the Matsya, Kūrma, Liṅga, Śiva, Skanda and Agni are tāmasa; the Viṣṇu, Nāradīya, Bhāgavata, Garuḍa, Padma and Varāha are sāttvika; the Brahmāṇḍa, Brahmavaivarta, Mārkaṇḍeya, Bhaviṣya, Vāmana and Brahma are rājasa.
speaker: Śiva

location.section: Brahmakhaṇḍa (as cited by Gauḍīya authors; locator not verified)

paraphrase: The ten offences against the name: reviling the saints, regarding Śiva's names and qualities as independent of Viṣṇu's, disregarding the teacher, deriding scripture, taking the name's glory as exaggeration, giving interpretations of it, sinning on the strength of the name, equating it with ordinary pious acts, teaching it to the faithless, and lacking love for it though hearing its glory.
speaker: Sanatkumāra (as cited)
